reason: It's free and it saves me the app-switching between Discord and whatever reader site I'm on — I read on my phone at night, so 'where I stopped' actually matters to me.
objection: Honestly, Discord plus a shared folder already works fine and everyone's already there; I'd probably end up reading on this site but still keep chat in Discord, so now I have two things to check instead of one.
would_change_my_mind: If the group chat actually moves over there, I'm in — if nobody else ever opens it, I'll just drift back to Discord and forget the site exists.
